sentences.en: The doctors wore white masks over their mouths and noses.
sentences.zh: 医生们戴着白色口罩遮住口鼻。

sentences.en: I don't mean to poke my nose into your affairs.
sentences.zh: 我不是要干涉你的事情。

sentences.en: He is suffering from a bad cold in the nose.
sentences.zh: 他患了重感冒，鼻子不通。
